prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible, approach and grab it, then inspect its properties. Move and deposit object. Explore area, if unsuccessful. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = InspectObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = DepositObject    /> <Action ID = ExploreArea    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectGrabbable    /> <Condition ID = IsCarryingObject    /> <Condition ID = IsAtDestination    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO ApproachObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectGrabbable? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO InspectObjectProperties
	END
